<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script>jQuery(function () {
  var $ = jQuery;
  var modal = GlideModal.get();
  var snIncidentId = modal.getPreference('snIncidentId');
  var api = x_pd_integration.AjaxHelper.ajaxClientFor('PagerDutyRenotifyController');
  var busy = false;
  var REFRESH_MS = 5000;
  var AFTER_ACTION_REFRESHES = 6; // about 30 seconds: a state change reaches ServiceNow by webhook a few seconds after the click
  var PLACEHOLDER = 'Choose an escalation policy or a person…';
  var refreshTimer = null;
  var refreshesAfterAction = 0;
  var policies = [];
  var people = [];
  var selected = '';      // 'policy:<id>' or 'user:<id>', '' when nothing is chosen
  var optionsShown = null;
  var awaiting = {};      // person key -> the state they had when asked again, until PagerDuty's answer reaches ServiceNow

  var $loading = $('.pd-renotify-loading');
  var $message = $('.pd-renotify-message');
  var $picker = $('.pd-renotify-picker');
  var $select = $('.pd-renotify-select');
  var $go = $('.pd-renotify-go');
  var $status = $('.pd-renotify-status');
  var $details = $('.pd-renotify-details');
  var $policiesHeading = $('.pd-renotify-policies-heading');
  var $table = $('.pd-renotify-table');
  var $rows = $('.pd-renotify-rows');
  var $peopleHeading = $('.pd-renotify-people-heading');
  var $peopleTable = $('.pd-renotify-people');
  var $peopleRows = $('.pd-renotify-people-rows');

  function showMessage(text) {
    $loading.hide();
    $message.text(text).show();
    $picker.hide();
    $status.hide();
    $details.hide();
  }

  var RUN_ENDED = {
    joined: { tone: 'good', badge: 'Someone joined', title: 'The run stopped when a responder joined' },
    exhausted: { tone: 'warn', badge: 'Reached the end', title: 'Every level and loop was tried without anyone joining' },
    resolved: { tone: 'muted', badge: 'Stopped', title: 'The incident was resolved' },
    cancelled: { tone: 'muted', badge: 'Stopped', title: 'Stopped from this dialog' },
    failed: { tone: 'bad', badge: 'Failed', title: 'The run stopped because of an error' }
  };

  /** One word for a responder's state, whatever the app calls it: pending, joined, declined or cancelled. */
  function stateKind(state) {
    var text = String(state || '').toLowerCase();
    if (text === 'accepted' || text === 'joined') {
      return 'joined';
    }
    return /^(pending|declined|cancelled)$/.test(text) ? text : '';
  }

  function stateTone(state) {
    return { pending: 'warn', joined: 'good', declined: 'bad', cancelled: 'muted' }[stateKind(state)] || 'muted';
  }

  function plural(count, one, many) {
    return count + ' ' + (count === 1 ? one : many);
  }

  /** A short text for tables and the like: "Renotifying: level 2", "Last run: Someone joined". */
  function policyStatus(item) {
    if (!item.runState) {
      return 'Not renotified';
    }
    if (item.runActive) {
      return 'Renotifying: level ' + item.runLevel;
    }
    return 'Last run: ' + ((RUN_ENDED[item.runState] || {}).badge || item.runState);
  }

  function personStatus(person) {
    var key = 'user:' + person.id;
    if (awaiting[key] !== undefined) {
      if (person.state === awaiting[key] && (busy || refreshesAfterAction > 0)) {
        return 'Request sent, waiting for PagerDuty…';
      }
      delete awaiting[key];
    }
    return person.state || '';
  }

  function policyView(item) {
    var facts = [];
    if (!item.runState) {
      return { kind: 'Escalation policy', name: item.text, tone: 'muted', badge: 'Not renotified', title: '', facts: [['Next', 'Renotify starts at level 1 and asks whoever is on call now']] };
    }
    var view;
    if (item.runActive) {
      var levelOf = item.runLevelCount ? ' of ' + item.runLevelCount : '';
      view = { kind: 'Escalation policy', name: item.text, tone: 'info', badge: 'Renotifying', title: 'Level ' + item.runLevel + levelOf, facts: facts };
      if (item.runNumLoops !== undefined && item.runLevelCount) {
        facts.push(['Round', (Number(item.runLoop) + 1) + ' of ' + (Number(item.runNumLoops) + 1)]);
      }
      if (item.runWaiting && item.runWaiting.length) {
        facts.push(['Waiting on', item.runWaiting.map(function (w) { return w.name + ' (' + w.state + ')'; }).join(', ')]);
      }
    } else {
      var ended = RUN_ENDED[item.runState] || { tone: 'muted', badge: item.runState, title: '' };
      view = { kind: 'Escalation policy', name: item.text, tone: ended.tone, badge: ended.badge, title: ended.title, facts: facts };
      if (item.runState === 'failed' && item.runError) {
        facts.push(['Error', item.runError]);
      }
    }
    if (item.runStarted) {
      facts.push(['Started', item.runStarted]);
    }
    if (item.runUpdated && item.runUpdated !== item.runStarted) {
      facts.push(['Last change', item.runUpdated]);
    }
    return view;
  }

  function personView(person) {
    var text = personStatus(person);
    var facts = [];
    var view;
    if (text.indexOf('Request sent') === 0) {
      view = { kind: 'Individual', name: person.text, tone: 'info', badge: 'Request sent', title: 'Waiting for PagerDuty…', facts: facts };
    } else {
      view = { kind: 'Individual', name: person.text, tone: stateTone(person.state), badge: person.state || 'Unknown', title: '', facts: facts };
    }
    if (person.via) {
      facts.push(['Added', person.via]);
    }
    if (person.updated) {
      facts.push(['Last change', person.updated]);
    }
    return view;
  }

  /** Before anything is chosen: what is on this incident at a glance. */
  function overviewView() {
    var counts = { pending: 0, joined: 0, declined: 0, cancelled: 0 };
    people.forEach(function (person) {
      var kind = stateKind(person.state);
      if (kind) {
        counts[kind]++;
      }
    });
    var running = policies.filter(function (item) { return item.runActive; }).length;
    var chips = [
      { tone: 'warn', text: 'Pending ' + counts.pending },
      { tone: 'good', text: 'Joined ' + counts.joined },
      { tone: 'bad', text: 'Declined ' + counts.declined }
    ];
    if (counts.cancelled) {
      chips.push({ tone: 'muted', text: 'Cancelled ' + counts.cancelled });
    }
    var facts = [];
    if (policies.length) {
      facts.push(['Escalation policies', plural(policies.length, 'policy', 'policies') + (running ? ', ' + running + ' being renotified now' : '') + ' (choose one to renotify it level by level)']);
    }
    if (people.length) {
      facts.push(['Individuals', plural(people.length, 'person', 'people') + ' available to renotify']);
    }
    return { tone: running ? 'info' : 'muted', badge: '', title: 'Choose something to renotify', chips: chips, facts: facts };
  }

  function findSelected() {
    var kind = selected.split(':')[0];
    var id = selected.slice(kind.length + 1);
    var list = kind === 'policy' ? policies : people;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (list[i].id === id) {
        return { kind: kind, item: list[i] };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // A run goes on after the dialog is opened (replies, timeouts), and so does a pending request: keep the status
  // current while either exists, and for a short while after any action, when the change has not arrived yet.
  function scheduleRefresh() {
    if (refreshTimer) {
      clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
      refreshTimer = null;
    }
    var waiting = policies.some(function (item) { return item.runActive; }) ||
      people.some(function (person) { return person.state === 'Pending'; }) ||
      refreshesAfterAction > 0;
    if (!waiting) {
      return;
    }
    refreshTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      refreshTimer = null;
      if (!$('.pd-renotify-form').length) {
        return; // the dialog was closed
      }
      if (refreshesAfterAction > 0) {
        refreshesAfterAction--;
      }
      if (!busy) {
        load();
      } else {
        scheduleRefresh();
      }
    }, REFRESH_MS);
  }

  /** Rebuilt only when the choices themselves change, so a refresh never closes the list or loses the selection. */
  function renderOptions() {
    var signature = JSON.stringify([
      policies.map(function (p) { return [p.id, p.text]; }),
      people.map(function (p) { return [p.id, p.text]; })
    ]);
    if (signature === optionsShown) {
      return;
    }
    optionsShown = signature;
    $select.empty().append($('<option></option>').attr('value', '').text(PLACEHOLDER));
    function group(label, kind, list) {
      if (!list.length) {
        return;
      }
      var $group = $('<optgroup></optgroup>').attr('label', label);
      list.forEach(function (item) {
        $group.append($('<option></option>').attr('value', kind + ':' + item.id).text(item.text));
      });
      $select.append($group);
    }
    group('Escalation policies', 'policy', policies);
    group('Individuals', 'user', people);
    if (!findSelected()) {
      selected = '';
    }
    $select.val(selected);
  }

  function paintStatus(view) {
    var $kind = view.kind
      ? $('<div class="pd-status-kind"></div>')
        .append($('<span class="pd-kind-tag"></span>').addClass(view.kind === 'Individual' ? 'individual' : 'policy').text(view.kind))
        .append($('<span class="pd-kind-name"></span>').text(view.name))
      : '';
    var $head = $('<div class="pd-status-head"></div>');
    if (busy) {
      $head.append($('<span class="pd-renotify-spinner small" aria-hidden="true"></span>'));
    }
    if (view.badge) {
      $head.append($('<span class="pd-badge"></span>').addClass('tone-' + view.tone).text(view.badge));
    }
    if (view.title) {
      $head.append($('<span class="pd-status-title"></span>').text(view.title));
    }
    (view.chips || []).forEach(function (chip) {
      $head.append($('<span class="pd-badge"></span>').addClass('tone-' + chip.tone).text(chip.text));
    });
    var $facts = $('<dl class="pd-status-facts"></dl>');
    view.facts.forEach(function (fact) {
      $facts.append($('<dt></dt>').text(fact[0]));
      $facts.append($('<dd></dd>').addClass(fact[0] === 'Error' ? 'pd-status-error' : '').text(fact[1]));
    });
    $status
      .removeClass('tone-info tone-good tone-warn tone-bad tone-muted')
      .addClass('tone-' + view.tone)
      .empty()
      .append($kind)
      .append($head)
      .append(view.facts.length ? $facts : '')
      .show();
  }

  function renderStatus() {
    var choice = selected && findSelected();
    var label = 'Renotify';
    if (choice) {
      paintStatus(choice.kind === 'policy' ? policyView(choice.item) : personView(choice.item));
      if (choice.kind === 'policy' && choice.item.runActive) {
        label = 'Stop';
      }
    } else {
      paintStatus(overviewView());
    }
    $go.text(label).attr('disabled', busy || !choice);
    $select.attr('disabled', busy);
  }

  function renderDetails() {
    $rows.empty();
    policies.forEach(function (item) {
      $rows.append($('<tr></tr>').append($('<td></td>').text(item.text)).append($('<td></td>').text(policyStatus(item))));
    });
    $policiesHeading.toggle(policies.length > 0);
    $table.toggle(policies.length > 0);
    $peopleRows.empty();
    people.forEach(function (person) {
      $peopleRows.append(
        $('<tr></tr>')
          .append($('<td></td>').text(person.text))
          .append($('<td></td>').text(personStatus(person)))
          .append($('<td></td>').text(person.via || ''))
      );
    });
    $peopleHeading.toggle(people.length > 0);
    $peopleTable.toggle(people.length > 0);
  }

  function render() {
    if (!policies.length && !people.length) {
      showMessage('Nobody has been added to this incident yet. Use Add Responders first.');
      return;
    }
    $loading.hide();
    $message.hide();
    $picker.show();
    $details.show();
    renderOptions();
    renderStatus();
    renderDetails();
  }

  function reportError(error) {
    jslog(error);
    g_form.addErrorMessage(error.message || 'Unknown error. Details: ' + JSON.stringify(error));
  }

  function load() {
    var loadedPolicies = policies; // a list that cannot be read keeps what was shown
    var loadedPeople = people;
    var failed = false;
    var outstanding = 2;
    function finished() {
      outstanding--;
      if (outstanding > 0) {
        return;
      }
      policies = loadedPolicies;
      people = loadedPeople;
      if (failed && !policies.length && !people.length) {
        showMessage('Could not load the responders of this incident.');
        return;
      }
      render();
      scheduleRefresh();
    }
    api.listEscalationPolicies(snIncidentId, function (error, data) {
      if (error) {
        failed = true;
        reportError(error);
      } else {
        loadedPolicies = data.items;
      }
      finished();
    });
    api.listResponders(snIncidentId, function (error, data) {
      if (error) {
        failed = true;
        reportError(error);
      } else {
        loadedPeople = data.items;
      }
      finished();
    });
  }

  function perform(call) {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }
    busy = true;
    renderStatus();
    call(function (error, result) {
      busy = false;
      if (error) {
        reportError(error);
      } else if (result && result.message) {
        g_form.addInfoMessage(result.message);
      }
      refreshesAfterAction = AFTER_ACTION_REFRESHES;
      load();
    });
  }

  function onGo() {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }
    var choice = selected && findSelected();
    if (!choice) {
      return;
    }
    if (choice.kind === 'policy') {
      perform(function (done) {
        if (choice.item.runActive) {
          api.cancel(choice.item.runId, done);
        } else {
          api.renotify({ snIncidentId: snIncidentId, pdPolicyId: choice.item.id, currentUser: g_user.userID }, done);
        }
      });
    } else {
      // PagerDuty's answer reaches ServiceNow by webhook a few seconds later: say so rather than show the old state
      if (choice.item.state !== 'Pending') {
        awaiting[selected] = choice.item.state;
      }
      perform(function (done) {
        api.renotifyUser({ snIncidentId: snIncidentId, pdUserId: choice.item.id, currentUser: g_user.userID }, done);
      });
    }
  }

  $select.on('change', function () {
    selected = $select.val() || '';
    renderStatus();
  });

  $go.on('click', function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    onGo();
  });

  $('.pd-renotify-form button.submit-cancel').on('click', function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (refreshTimer) {
      clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
    }
    modal.destroy();
  });

  load();
});
</client_script><description>Renotify an escalation policy already added to an incident</description><direct>false</direct><endpoint>x_pd_integration_renotify_dialog.do</endpoint><html><?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>

  var me = 'PD Renotify Escalation Policy on Webhook';

  // An escalation policy renotification run must never break regular webhook processing.
  try {
    var payload = JSON.parse(current.getValue('payload'));

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotify</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Renotifies an escalation policy on a PagerDuty incident level by level</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PagerDutyRenotify</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*** Changes made to this script are not supported by PagerDuty ***/
/**
 * Renotifies an escalation policy (EP) on a PagerDuty incident from ServiceNow.
 *
 * Re-adding an EP as a responder in PagerDuty is not reliable (it re-requests level 1 at best), so this class
 * drives the behaviour itself, level by level, as if the EP was being added for the first time. The decision
 * logic lives in PagerDutyRenotifyMachine (pure, no I/O); this class persists the run in
 * x_pd_integration_renotify_run and performs the PagerDuty calls the machine asks for.
 *
 * Entry points:
 *  - start(): user clicks "Renotify" on an escalation policy.
 *  - renotifyUser(): user clicks "Renotify" on an individual responder.
 *  - handleReplyEvent() / handleResolvedEvent(): called from the inbound v3 webhook handler.
 *  - flush(): executes the actions a run is waiting on (event script action, tick).
 *  - tick(): scheduled job; advances levels whose delay has elapsed.
 */
var PagerDutyRenotify = Class.create();
PagerDutyRenotify.prototype = {
  type: 'PagerDutyRenotify',

  TABLE: 'x_pd_integration_renotify_run',
  EVENT: 'x_pd_integration.renotify_run',
  MAX_ONCALL_PAGES: 5,
  REQUESTED_TOLERANCE_MS: 1000, // clock difference allowed between PagerDuty's timestamps and the moment a level became due

  /**
   * @param {Object} [deps] collaborators to use instead of the real ones, so tests need no PagerDuty and no network:
   *   deps.rest() returns an object like PagerDuty_REST, deps.pd() one like PagerDuty (user lookups), deps.defaultUser is the
   *   PagerDuty user to ask on behalf of, deps.incident(snIncidentSysId) returns the PagerDuty incident id it is linked to (or
   *   null when there is no such incident), deps.queue(runRecord) is called instead of queueing the platform event that runs the
   *   follow-up work. Production code passes nothing.
   */
  initialize: function (deps) {
    this.machine = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyMachine();
    this.deps = deps || {};
  },

  /** Queues the platform event that runs the follow-up work of a run (the Script Action calls flush). */
  _queueFlush: function (runRecord) {
    if (this.deps.queue) {
      this.deps.queue(runRecord);
    } else {
      gs.eventQueue(this.EVENT, runRecord, runRecord.getUniqueValue(), '');
    }
  },

  _newRest: function () {
    return this.deps.rest ? this.deps.rest() : new x_pd_integration.PagerDuty_REST();
  },

  _newPd: function () {
    return this.deps.pd ? this.deps.pd() : new x_pd_integration.PagerDuty();
  },

  /**
   * Starts renotifying an EP on an incident and sends the first level synchronously so the caller sees failures.
   * @param {String} snIncidentSysId incident sys_id
   * @param {String} pdPolicyId PagerDuty escalation policy id
   * @param {String} snUserSysId sys_user of the person clicking Renotify (becomes the PagerDuty requester)
   * @returns {{runId:String, policyName:String}}
   */
  start: function (snIncidentSysId, pdPolicyId, snUserSysId) {
    var me = 'start';
    var context = this._requestContext(snIncidentSysId, snUserSysId);
    var pdIncidentId = context.pdIncidentId;
    var requesterPdId = context.requesterPdId;

    if (this._findActiveRun(pdIncidentId, pdPolicyId)) {
      throw new Error('This escalation policy is already being renotified on this incident');
    }

    var policy = this._getPolicy(pdPolicyId);
    var built = this.machine.buildRules(policy);

    var started = this.machine.start({
      incidentId: pdIncidentId,
      policyId: pdPolicyId,
      requesterId: requesterPdId,
      rules: built.rules,
      numLoops: built.numLoops
    }, this._now());

    var gr = this._insertRun(started.run, snIncidentSysId, policy.name);
    this._apply(gr, started.run, started.actions);
    this.flush(gr.getUniqueValue());

    gr.get(gr.getUniqueValue());
    if (gr.getValue('state') === 'failed') {
      throw new Error(gr.getValue('last_error'));
    }
    gs.debug('{0} started run {1} for policy {2}', me, gr.getUniqueValue(), pdPolicyId);
    return { runId: gr.getUniqueValue(), policyName: policy.name };
  },

  /**
   * Requests one responder again, whether they were added on their own or through an escalation policy.
   * No escalation logic: PagerDuty notifies them, and their reply is theirs to give.
   * @param {String} snIncidentSysId incident sys_id
   * @param {String} pdUserId PagerDuty user id of the responder
   * @param {String} snUserSysId sys_user of the person clicking Renotify (becomes the PagerDuty requester)
   * @returns {{pdUserId:String}}
   */
  renotifyUser: function (snIncidentSysId, pdUserId, snUserSysId) {
    if (gs.nil(pdUserId)) {
      throw new Error('Please choose a responder to renotify');
    }
    var context = this._requestContext(snIncidentSysId, snUserSysId);
    this._requestResponders(null, {
      incidentId: context.pdIncidentId,
      requesterId: context.requesterPdId,
      userIds: [pdUserId]
    }, null);
    return { pdUserId: pdUserId };
  },

  /**
   * Stops an active run. Whatever has already been requested stays requested in PagerDuty.
   * @param {String} runSysId
   */
  cancel: function (runSysId) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
    if (!gr.get(runSysId) || gr.getValue('active') !== '1') {
      return;
    }
    var run = JSON.parse(gr.getValue('run_json'));
    run.state = 'cancelled';
    run.phase = null;
    this._apply(gr, run, []);
  },

  /**
   * incident.responder.replied webhook (v3). Updates matching runs and queues the follow-up work.
   * @param {Object} payload v3 webhook payload
   */
  handleReplyEvent: function (payload) {
    var me = 'handleReplyEvent';
    var data = payload.data;
    if (gs.nil(data) || gs.nil(data.incident) || gs.nil(data.user)) {
      return;
    }
    var repliedAt = new Date(payload.occurred_at).getTime();
    var runs = this._activeRuns(data.incident.id);
    while (runs.next()) {
      var run = JSON.parse(runs.getValue('run_json'));
      var result = this.machine.onReply(run, data.user.id, data.state, this._now(), isNaN(repliedAt) ? undefined : repliedAt);
      this._apply(runs, result.run, result.actions);
      if (result.actions.length) {
        this._queueFlush(runs);
      }
      gs.debug('{0} run={1} user={2} state={3} -> {4}', me, runs.getUniqueValue(), data.user.id, data.state, result.run.state);
    }
  },

  /**
   * incident.resolved webhook (v3). Ends active runs on that incident.
   * @param {Object} payload v3 webhook payload
   */
  handleResolvedEvent: function (payload) {
    if (gs.nil(payload.data) || gs.nil(payload.data.id)) {
      return;
    }
    var runs = this._activeRuns(payload.data.id);
    while (runs.next()) {
      var result = this.machine.onIncidentStatus(JSON.parse(runs.getValue('run_json')), 'resolved', false);
      this._apply(runs, result.run, []);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Scheduled job: advance levels whose delay has elapsed, then run what is queued.
   * @param {String} [pdIncidentId] only advance runs on this PagerDuty incident (tests use it to leave other runs alone)
   */
  tick: function (pdIncidentId) {
    var runs = this._activeRuns(pdIncidentId);
    while (runs.next()) {
      var before = runs.getValue('run_json');
      var result = this.machine.onTick(JSON.parse(before), this._now());
      var actions = result.actions;
      if (!actions.length && result.run.phase === 'resolving' && gs.nil(runs.getValue('pending_actions'))) {
        // Recovery: a flush died after claiming its actions, leaving the run waiting for a level to be resolved.
        actions = [{ type: 'resolveLevel', level: result.run.rules[result.run.levelIndex].level }];
      }
      // Save whenever the run changed, not only when there is something to send: running out of levels (exhausted) has no action.
      if (actions.length || JSON.stringify(result.run) !== before) {
        this._apply(runs, result.run, actions);
      }
      this.flush(runs.getUniqueValue());
    }
  },

  /**
   * Executes the actions a run is waiting on. Safe to call when nothing is pending.
   * @param {String} runSysId
   */
  flush: function (runSysId) {
    var me = 'flush';
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
    if (!gr.get(runSysId)) {
      return;
    }
    var pending = this._parse(gr.getValue('pending_actions'), []);
    if (!pending.length) {
      return;
    }
    // Claim the actions before doing I/O so a concurrent flush does not send them twice.
    gr.setValue('pending_actions', '');
    gr.update();

    var run = JSON.parse(gr.getValue('run_json'));
    var queue = pending.slice();
    var error = '';
    try {
      while (queue.length && run.state === 'active') {
        var action = queue.shift();
        if (action.type === 'resolveLevel') {
          var userIds = this._getOnCallUserIds(run.policyId, action.level);
          queue = queue.concat(this.machine.onLevelResolved(run, userIds, this._now()).actions);
        } else if (action.type === 'requestResponders') {
          this._requestResponders(run, action, gr.getValue('policy_name'));
        }
      }
    } catch (ex) {
      error = ex.message || String(ex);
      gs.error('{0} run={1} failed: {2}', me, runSysId, error);
      run.state = 'failed';
      run.phase = null;
    }
    this._apply(gr, run, [], error);
  },

  /** Checks the incident and the clicking user are linked to PagerDuty. */
  _requestContext: function (snIncidentSysId, snUserSysId) {
    var pdIncidentId;
    if (this.deps.incident) {
      pdIncidentId = this.deps.incident(snIncidentSysId);
      if (pdIncidentId === null) {
        throw new Error('You can not use this form out of context of existing incident');
      }
    } else {
      var incident = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');
      if (!incident.get(snIncidentSysId)) {
        throw new Error('You can not use this form out of context of existing incident');
      }
      pdIncidentId = incident.getValue('x_pd_integration_incident');
    }
    if (gs.nil(pdIncidentId)) {
      throw new Error('Current incident is not linked to PagerDuty');
    }
    var requesterPdId = this._newPd().getUserIDFromFieldData(snUserSysId, 'sys_id', true);
    if (gs.nil(requesterPdId)) {
      throw new Error('Current user is not mapped to a PagerDuty user');
    }
    return { pdIncidentId: pdIncidentId, requesterPdId: requesterPdId };
  },

  _getPolicy: function (pdPolicyId) {
    var rest = this._newRest();
    var result = rest.getREST('escalation_policies/' + pdPolicyId);
    this._assertOk(rest, result, 'Could not fetch the escalation policy');
    return JSON.parse(result.getBody()).escalation_policy;
  },

  /**
   * On-calls are resolved when each level is reached, as PagerDuty does, so shift changes during a long run count.
   * @returns {String[]} PagerDuty user ids on call for the level right now
   */
  _getOnCallUserIds: function (pdPolicyId, level) {
    var rest = this._newRest();
    var oncalls = [];
    var offset = 0;
    for (var page = 0; page < this.MAX_ONCALL_PAGES; page++) {
      // The brackets must be percent-encoded: the platform's REST client rejects a raw '[]' in the query ("Invalid query").
      var feature = 'oncalls?escalation_policy_ids%5B%5D=' + encodeURIComponent(pdPolicyId) + '&limit=100&offset=' + offset;
      var result = rest.getREST(feature);
      this._assertOnCallsAllowed(result);
      this._assertOk(rest, result, 'Could not fetch on-calls');
      var body = JSON.parse(result.getBody());
      oncalls = oncalls.concat(body.oncalls || []);
      if (!body.more) {
        break;
      }
      offset += 100;
    }
    return this.machine.usersForLevel(oncalls, level);
  },

  /**
   * PagerDuty may already have asked someone for this level itself: a policy added to the incident keeps escalating, and a
   * decline moves it on. They were just notified, so asking again would send a second text. Returns the people still to ask.
   * Best effort: when PagerDuty cannot be read everyone is asked.
   */
  _notYetRequested: function (run, action) {
    var me = '_notYetRequested';
    if (gs.nil(run) || gs.nil(run.resolveStartedAt)) {
      return action.userIds;
    }
    try {
      var rest = this._newRest();
      var result = rest.getREST('incidents/' + action.incidentId);
      if (rest.hasError() || gs.nil(result) || result.haveError()) {
        return action.userIds;
      }
      var since = run.resolveStartedAt - this.REQUESTED_TOLERANCE_MS;
      var justAsked = {};
      var askedAt = {};
      (JSON.parse(result.getBody()).incident.incidents_responders || []).forEach(function (responder) {
        if (responder.state === 'pending' && responder.user && new Date(responder.requested_at).getTime() >= since) {
          justAsked[responder.user.id] = true;
          askedAt[responder.user.id] = new Date(responder.requested_at).getTime();
        }
      });
      var toAsk = action.userIds.filter(function (id) { return !justAsked[id]; });
      if (toAsk.length !== action.userIds.length) {
        // their answers count from when PagerDuty asked them
        this.machine.onAlreadyAsked(run, askedAt);
        gs.debug('{0} PagerDuty had already asked {1} of {2} for this level', me, action.userIds.length - toAsk.length, action.userIds.length);
      }
      return toAsk;
    } catch (ex) {
      gs.warn('{0} could not check who PagerDuty already asked: {1}', me, ex.message);
      return action.userIds;
    }
  },

  _requestResponders: function (run, action, policyName) {
    var pd = this._newPd();
    var rest = this._newRest();
    var message = policyName
      ? 'Renotification of escalation policy "' + policyName + '" requested from ServiceNow'
      : 'Renotification requested from ServiceNow';

    // PagerDuty silently ignores a request whose requester is the responder (no state change, no notification), and the
    // person clicking Renotify may be on call too. Their own request is therefore made on behalf of someone else.
    var toAsk = this._notYetRequested(run, action);
    var others = toAsk.filter(function (id) { return id !== action.requesterId; });
    var requesterHimself = toAsk.filter(function (id) { return id === action.requesterId; });
    var batches = [];
    if (others.length) {
      batches.push({ requesterId: action.requesterId, userIds: others });
    }
    if (requesterHimself.length) {
      batches.push({ requesterId: this._otherRequester(action.requesterId), userIds: requesterHimself });
    }

    for (var b = 0; b < batches.length; b++) {
      var batch = batches[b];
      var body = {
        requester_id: batch.requesterId,
        message: message,
        responder_request_targets: batch.userIds.map(function (id) {
          return { responder_request_target: { id: id, type: 'user_reference' } };
        })
      };
      var from = pd.getUserEmailByPDID(batch.requesterId);
      var result = rest.postREST('incidents/' + action.incidentId + '/responder_requests', body, from);
      this._assertOk(rest, result, 'Could not request responders');
    }
  },

  /** Another PagerDuty user to make a request on behalf of: the app's default user. */
  _otherRequester: function (requesterPdId) {
    var fallback = this.deps.defaultUser !== undefined ? this.deps.defaultUser : gs.getProperty('x_pd_integration.default_user');
    if (gs.nil(fallback) || fallback === requesterPdId) {
      gs.warn('_otherRequester there is no other PagerDuty user to ask {0} on behalf of; PagerDuty will ignore the request', requesterPdId);
      return requesterPdId;
    }
    return fallback;
  },

  /**
   * PagerDuty refusing the on-calls request (401/403) is, on an installation that uses scoped OAuth, almost always the missing
   * oncalls.read scope, which the integration's shipped provider does not request. Say so, instead of only the HTTP error.
   */
  _assertOnCallsAllowed: function (result) {
    var status = !gs.nil(result) && result.getStatusCode ? Number(result.getStatusCode()) : 0;
    if (status === 401 || status === 403) {
      throw new Error('Could not fetch on-calls: PagerDuty refused the request (HTTP ' + status + '). If this installation uses scoped OAuth, ' +
        'the PagerDuty OAuth app and the integration\'s OAuth provider need the oncalls.read scope.');
    }
  },

  _assertOk: function (rest, result, what) {
    if (rest.hasError()) {
      throw new Error(what + ': ' + rest.getError());
    }
    if (gs.nil(result) || result.haveError()) {
      throw new Error(what + ': ' + (result ? result.getErrorMessage() + '. ' + result.getBody() : 'no response'));
    }
  },

  _insertRun: function (run, snIncidentSysId, policyName) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
    gr.initialize();
    gr.setValue('incident', snIncidentSysId);
    gr.setValue('pd_incident_id', run.incidentId);
    gr.setValue('pd_policy_id', run.policyId);
    gr.setValue('policy_name', policyName);
    gr.setValue('requester_pd_id', run.requesterId);
    gr.insert();
    return gr;
  },

  /** Saves the run and the actions it is waiting on; keeps the display columns in sync. */
  _apply: function (gr, run, actions, error) {
    gr.setValue('run_json', JSON.stringify(run));
    if (actions.length) {
      // Append: a duplicate or concurrent event must not discard actions that are still waiting to be sent.
      gr.setValue('pending_actions', JSON.stringify(this._parse(gr.getValue('pending_actions'), []).concat(actions)));
    }
    gr.setValue('state', run.state);
    gr.setValue('active', run.state === 'active');
    gr.setValue('level', run.rules[run.levelIndex] ? run.rules[run.levelIndex].level : 0);
    gr.setValue('loop', run.loop);
    if (error) {
      gr.setValue('last_error', error);
    }
    gr.update();
  },

  _findActiveRun: function (pdIncidentId, pdPolicyId) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
    gr.addQuery('active', true);
    gr.addQuery('pd_incident_id', pdIncidentId);
    gr.addQuery('pd_policy_id', pdPolicyId);
    gr.setLimit(1);
    gr.query();
    return gr.next();
  },

  _activeRuns: function (pdIncidentId) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
    gr.addQuery('active', true);
    if (pdIncidentId) {
      gr.addQuery('pd_incident_id', pdIncidentId);
    }
    gr.query();
    return gr;
  },

  _parse: function (text, fallback) {
    return gs.nil(text) ? fallback : JSON.parse(text);
  },

  _now: function () {
    return new Date().getTime();
  }
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-08 17:30:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b22ce7b6e44345108dcc9e7ce8db9e10</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PagerDutyRenotify</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_b22ce7b6e44345108dcc9e7ce8db9e10</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-08 17:30:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyController</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PagerDutyRenotifyController</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*** Changes made to this script are not supported by PagerDuty ***/
var PagerDutyRenotifyController = x_pd_integration.AjaxHelper.createAjaxController({
  type: 'PagerDutyRenotifyController',

  /**
   * Escalation policies already added to the incident as responders, with the state of any renotification run.
   * @param {String} snIncidentId incident sys_id
   */
  listEscalationPolicies: function listEscalationPolicies(snIncidentId) {
    var pdPolicyIds = [];
    var requests = new GlideRecordSecure('x_pd_integration_pagerduty_response_requests');
    requests.addQuery('incident', snIncidentId);
    requests.addNotNullQuery('pd_group_id');
    requests.query();
    while (requests.next()) {
      var pdPolicyId = requests.getValue('pd_group_id');
      if (!gs.nil(pdPolicyId) && pdPolicyIds.indexOf(pdPolicyId) === -1) {
        pdPolicyIds.push(pdPolicyId);
      }
    }

    var items = pdPolicyIds.map(function (pdPolicyId) {
      var run = findLatestRun(snIncidentId, pdPolicyId);
      var item = {
        id: pdPolicyId,
        text: getPolicyName(pdPolicyId),
        runId: run ? run.getUniqueValue() : '',
        runState: run ? run.getValue('state') : '',
        runLevel: run ? run.getValue('level') : '',
        runActive: run ? run.getValue('active') === '1' : false
      };
      if (run) {
        addRunDetails(item, run);
      }
      return item;
    });
    return { items: items };
  },

  /**
   * Everyone already added to the incident as a responder, once each, whether they were added on their own or
   * through an escalation policy (a policy adds its on-call users one by one).
   * @param {String} snIncidentId incident sys_id
   */
  listResponders: function listResponders(snIncidentId) {
    var byUser = {};
    var order = [];
    var requests = new GlideRecordSecure('x_pd_integration_pagerduty_response_requests');
    requests.addQuery('incident', snIncidentId);
    requests.addNotNullQuery('pd_user_id');
    requests.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on'); // newest row first: it carries the current state
    requests.query();
    while (requests.next()) {
      var pdUserId = requests.getValue('pd_user_id');
      if (gs.nil(pdUserId)) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!byUser[pdUserId]) {
        byUser[pdUserId] = {
          id: pdUserId,
          snName: requests.assigned_to.nil() ? '' : requests.assigned_to.getDisplayValue(),
          state: stateLabel(requests.getValue('state')),
          updated: requests.getDisplayValue('sys_updated_on'),
          individually: false,
          policyIds: []
        };
        order.push(pdUserId);
      }
      var pdPolicyId = requests.getValue('pd_group_id');
      if (gs.nil(pdPolicyId)) {
        byUser[pdUserId].individually = true;
      } else if (byUser[pdUserId].policyIds.indexOf(pdPolicyId) === -1) {
        byUser[pdUserId].policyIds.push(pdPolicyId);
      }
    }

    var items = order.map(function (pdUserId) {
      var u = byUser[pdUserId];
      var via = u.policyIds.map(function (id) { return getPolicyName(id); });
      if (u.individually) {
        via.unshift('individually');
      }
      return {
        id: pdUserId,
        text: u.snName || getUserName(pdUserId),
        state: u.state,
        updated: u.updated,
        via: via.join(', ')
      };
    });
    return { items: items };
  },

  renotifyUser: function renotifyUser(data) {
    new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotify().renotifyUser(data.snIncidentId, data.pdUserId, data.currentUser);
    return { message: 'Renotification request sent' };
  },

  renotify: function renotify(data) {
    var result = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotify().start(data.snIncidentId, data.pdPolicyId, data.currentUser);
    return {
      runId: result.runId,
      message: 'Renotifying escalation policy "' + result.policyName + '", starting at level 1'
    };
  },

  cancel: function cancel(runId) {
    new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotify().cancel(runId);
    return { message: 'Renotification stopped' };
  }
});

/**
 * The app records only pending, joined and declined and stores anything else as '(unknown)'. The one other state PagerDuty
 * has is user_cancelled (a request that was cancelled, for instance when a renotification takes over), so show that.
 */
function stateLabel(state) {
  return state === '(unknown)' ? 'Cancelled' : state;
}

/**
 * What the dialog shows about a run beyond its state: how far it has got, who it is waiting on, when it started and why it failed.
 * Best effort: a run whose saved state cannot be read still lists with the basics.
 */
function addRunDetails(item, run) {
  item.runStarted = run.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on');
  item.runUpdated = run.getDisplayValue('sys_updated_on');
  item.runLoop = run.getValue('loop');
  item.runError = run.getValue('last_error') || '';
  item.runWaiting = [];
  try {
    var saved = JSON.parse(run.getValue('run_json'));
    item.runLevelCount = saved.rules.length;
    item.runNumLoops = saved.numLoops;
    if (item.runActive) {
      Object.keys(saved.responses || {}).forEach(function (pdUserId) {
        item.runWaiting.push({ name: getUserName(pdUserId), state: saved.responses[pdUserId] });
      });
    }
  } catch (ex) {
    item.runLevelCount = 0;
    item.runNumLoops = 0;
  }
}

function getPolicyName(pdPolicyId) {
  var ep = new GlideRecordSecure('x_pd_integration_escalation_policies');
  ep.addQuery('escalation_policy_id', pdPolicyId);
  ep.setLimit(1);
  ep.query();
  if (ep.next()) {
    return ep.getValue('escalation_policy_name');
  }
  return nameFromPagerDuty('escalation_policies/' + pdPolicyId, 'escalation_policy') || pdPolicyId;
}

/** Name of a PagerDuty user: the ServiceNow user mapped to it, else PagerDuty's own name, else the id. */
function getUserName(pdUserId) {
  var user = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user');
  user.addQuery('x_pd_integration_pagerduty_id', pdUserId);
  user.setLimit(1);
  user.query();
  if (user.next()) {
    return user.getValue('name');
  }
  return nameFromPagerDuty('users/' + pdUserId, 'user') || pdUserId;
}

/** Best effort: a name lookup must never stop the dialog from opening. */
function nameFromPagerDuty(feature, key) {
  try {
    var rest = new x_pd_integration.PagerDuty_REST();
    var result = rest.getREST(feature);
    if (rest.hasError() || gs.nil(result) || result.haveError()) {
      return '';
    }
    var record = JSON.parse(result.getBody())[key];
    return record && record.name ? record.name : '';
  } catch (ex) {
    return '';
  }
}

function findLatestRun(snIncidentId, pdPolicyId) {
  var run = new GlideRecordSecure('x_pd_integration_renotify_run');
  run.addQuery('incident', snIncidentId);
  run.addQuery('pd_policy_id', pdPolicyId);
  run.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
  run.setLimit(1);
  run.query();
  return run.next() ? run : null;
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyMachine</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Pure state machine for renotifying an escalation policy</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PagerDutyRenotifyMachine</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*** Changes made to this script are not supported by PagerDuty ***/
/**
 * Pure state machine that mirrors what PagerDuty does when an escalation policy
 * (EP) is added to an incident as a responder for the first time, driven from
 * ServiceNow because re-adding an EP in PagerDuty is not reliable.
 *
 * Behaviour, per level, starting at level 1 regardless of earlier replies:
 *   1. Resolve who is on call for the level *now* and request them (this makes
 *      them pending again, even if they previously joined or declined).
 *   2. Wait for the level's delay.
 *   3. Any user joins -> stop; nothing else is touched (no cancels).
 *   4. Everyone requested on the level declines, or the delay elapses with no
 *      join -> go to the next level. After the last level, repeat the whole EP
 *      up to num_loops more times, then give up.
 *   A level with nobody on call is skipped immediately.
 *
 * No GlideRecord / HTTP in here: every function takes a run object and returns
 * { run, actions }. The ServiceNow Script Include persists the run and executes
 * the actions, feeding results back in. ES5 so it can be pasted unchanged.
 *
 * Actions:
 *   { type: 'resolveLevel', level }  fetch on-calls for the EP, call onLevelResolved(run, userIds, now)
 *   { type: 'requestResponders', incidentId, requesterId, userIds }  POST /incidents/{id}/responder_requests
 *
 * Each time a level becomes due the run records resolveStartedAt: the executor skips anyone PagerDuty itself asked after
 * that moment (its own escalation of the policy), so they are not asked twice.
 *
 * Run states: active | joined | exhausted | resolved
 * Run phases (while active): resolving | waiting
 * Responder states (PagerDuty): pending | joined | declined | user_cancelled
 */
var PagerDutyRenotifyMachine = Class.create();
PagerDutyRenotifyMachine.prototype = (function () {
  var MS_PER_MIN = 60000;

  /**
   * @param {Object} policy GET /escalation_policies/{id} escalation_policy
   * @returns {{rules:{level:number, delayMinutes:number}[], numLoops:number}}
   */
  function buildRules(policy) {
    return {
      rules: (policy.escalation_rules || []).map(function (rule, i) {
        // Oncall.escalation_level equals the rule's 1-based position (verified live).
        return { level: i + 1, delayMinutes: rule.escalation_delay_in_minutes };
      }),
      numLoops: policy.num_loops || 0
    };
  }

  /**
   * Distinct users on call for one level, from GET /oncalls?escalation_policy_ids[]=
   * @param {Object[]} oncalls
   * @param {number} level
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  function usersForLevel(oncalls, level) {
    var ids = [];
    (oncalls || []).forEach(function (o) {
      if (o.escalation_level !== level || !o.user || !o.user.id) return;
      if (ids.indexOf(o.user.id) === -1) ids.push(o.user.id);
    });
    return ids;
  }

  /** @param {number} at when this level became due (used to tell who PagerDuty has already asked for it) */
  function _resolve(run, at) {
    run.phase = 'resolving';
    run.responses = {};
    run.askedAt = {};
    run.resolveStartedAt = at;
    return [{ type: 'resolveLevel', level: run.rules[run.levelIndex].level }];
  }

  function _advance(run, at) {
    if (run.levelIndex + 1 < run.rules.length) {
      run.levelIndex++;
      return _resolve(run, at);
    }
    if (run.loop < run.numLoops) {
      run.loop++;
      run.levelIndex = 0;
      return _resolve(run, at);
    }
    run.state = 'exhausted';
    run.phase = null;
    return [];
  }

  /**
   * @param {{incidentId:string, policyId:string, requesterId:string, rules:Object[], numLoops:number}} params from buildRules
   * @param {number} now epoch ms
   */
  function start(params, now) {
    var run = {
      incidentId: params.incidentId,
      policyId: params.policyId,
      requesterId: params.requesterId,
      rules: params.rules,
      numLoops: params.numLoops || 0,
      loop: 0,
      levelIndex: 0,
      state: 'active',
      phase: null,
      responses: {},
      levelStartedAt: now
    };
    if (!run.rules.length) {
      run.state = 'exhausted';
      return { run: run, actions: [] };
    }
    return { run: run, actions: _resolve(run, now) };
  }

  /** The executor resolved the current level's on-calls. */
  function onLevelResolved(run, userIds, now) {
    if (run.state !== 'active' || run.phase !== 'resolving') return { run: run, actions: [] };
    if (!userIds.length) return { run: run, actions: _advance(run, now) };
    run.phase = 'waiting';
    run.levelStartedAt = now;
    run.responses = {};
    userIds.forEach(function (id) { run.responses[id] = 'pending'; });
    return {
      run: run,
      actions: [{ type: 'requestResponders', incidentId: run.incidentId, requesterId: run.requesterId, userIds: userIds.slice() }]
    };
  }

  /**
